decisions.reason: The existing message-281 MODIFY already captures the GPIO3-controlled 5V rail shutdown, affected LED load, and zero-standby policy.
The existing message-281 MODIFY already records the 5V LED supply and shutdown of the 5V rail through 5V_EN when the LEDs are not needed.
The 5V_EN control decision does not change connector placement, orientation, accessibility, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
Switching the 5V rail through GPIO3 does not alter the number or functional partitioning of the project boards.
The source decision does not change power-board dimensions, orientation, mounting, enclosure fit, or USB-C edge placement.
The existing message-281 MODIFY already removes the SK6812 LEDs from the loads represented by the standalone 3.3V rail.
The source places the LEDs on the switchable 5V rail, so they can no longer remain listed among the loads powered directly by DCDC1's 3.3V rail.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Doesn't the 5V_EN pin solve this? We can cut the entire 5V rail via GPIO3 when LEDs are not needed, dropping standby current to zero.

value_updates.normal_operation_role: Primary source for the ESP32-S3, INA219, downstream 3.3V sensors, I2C display, TTP223, and AM312 when the power board is connected

decisions.reason: The 5V_EN function does not change I2C routing, pull-ups, bus speed, cable length, or series-resistor conditioning.
The source defines LED standby-power control but does not change how charge status is signaled or the separate CHGLED interface.
The 5V_EN rail-control decision does not change USB enumeration, flashing, connector selection, or D+/D- routing.
The source decision does not affect the battery NTC terminal, connector, controller, or thermal-protection behavior.
AXP2101 remains the normal upstream power source for the system; selectively disabling its downstream boosted 5V rail does not invalidate the existing power-path state.
